rationale: Archive FleetLogix as a standalone manager-level PortCo while preserving it as an active LAZ-controlled operating company. LAZ acquired a majority interest in FleetLogix in 2025, Striker Partners and management reinvested, and the current FleetLogix site remains active under the FleetLogix Powered by LAZ brand. FleetLogix and LAZ remain distinct legal identities, so no canonical merge or redirect is appropriate. Argo's directly evidenced manager-level infrastructure investment is LAZ; FleetLogix is an acquisition beneath that platform. Retain one Argo audit period as indirect through LAZ, retire the unsupported duplicate Argo ownership row without recording a false economic exit, preserve LAZ's existing FleetLogix acquisition milestone, and record no Argo exit or pending transaction. The approved archive overlay removes FleetLogix from the evaluated manager-level seed list while retaining its legal and audit history in production.

beforeImage.name: FleetLogix, Inc.
beforeImage.subsector: Fleet management and transportation staffing services
beforeImage.description: FleetLogix provides fleet management, staffing, transportation, and related operational services for mobility and transportation customers. Its customers include rental car operators, fleet owners, and transportation providers that outsource labor-intensive fleet handling and support activities. The business is primarily service-based, although it is embedded in transportation operations that require recurring, site-based staffing and process management. Public company materials describe a nationwide operating footprint and identify the corporate office in San Diego, California. LAZ Parking announced in April 2025 that it had acquired a majority interest in FleetLogix, and the detailed post-transaction ownership percentages were not publicly disclosed.

afterImage.name: FleetLogix, Inc.
afterImage.subsector: Fleet management and transportation staffing services
afterImage.description: FleetLogix, Inc. is a San Diego-based provider of managed labor, fleet services and transportation staffing for rental-car operators and other mobility customers. LAZ Parking acquired a majority interest in FleetLogix in 2025, while Striker Partners and FleetLogix management reinvested. FleetLogix continues to operate under the FleetLogix Powered by LAZ brand. LAZ reported approximately 50 FleetLogix locations, including 37 airports in more than 20 states, and about 2,400 employees at acquisition. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ; FleetLogix is an active operating-company acquisition beneath that platform and is therefore archived from the standalone manager-level PortCo census. Public sources do not disclose the exact LAZ stake, FleetLogix closing date, Argo indirect percentage, fund vehicle, or founding year, and no later FleetLogix sale, legal merger, Argo exit or signed pending transaction was identified through August 16, 2026.
